articles.title: US summer generating capacity increases by 75 GW since 2025: FERC

articles.title: Puerto Rico’s power grid is ‘suspended between two realities,’ top utility regulator says
articles.summary: Affordability, reliability and the need to restore public confidence almost a decade after Hurricane Maria are top concerns, writes PREB Chairman Edison Avilés.

articles.title: AEP, other Ohio utilities could own nuclear power plants under state bill
articles.summary: The Ohio Manufacturers’ Association opposes the bill, saying it would give utilities a path back into the generation business with customers bearing the financial risks.

articles.title: Enbridge, Meta to build 365-MW solar/200-MW storage project
articles.summary: Enbridge expects to invest $1.2 billion into the Wyoming project’s construction and anticipates that it will enter service by the end of 2027.

articles.title: 76% of Americans want stronger utility oversight
articles.summary: A poll from consumer advocacy group PowerLines found broad distrust of elected officials and limited understanding of utilities’ business models. Experts told Utility Dive the disconnect could worsen.

articles.title: New Mexico regulators scrutinize Blackstone-TXNM stock trade in merger review
articles.summary: Consumer and renewable energy advocates say the stock transaction gave Blackstone an early stake in TXNM Energy before regulators could negotiate acquisition-related conditions or customer protections. The companies deny wrongdoing.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel is the weak link in US energy security: Centrus CMO
articles.summary: America must rebuild its nuclear fuel supply chain to reduce geopolitical risk, writes Centrus Energy CMO John Donelson. “No one company can do it alone.”

articles.title: FERC Commissioner Chang is ‘not thinking about’ breaking up PJM
articles.summary: “I'm interested in the successful continued operation of PJM, but definitely I want to help them get through this period,” FERC Commissioner Judy Chang told Utility Dive. She called the proposed NextEra-Dominion merger “interesting.”

articles.title: In-state geothermal could save California $44B annually: CATF
articles.summary: The Clean Air Task Force estimates that enhanced geothermal deployment could reduce the state’s need to expand interregional transmission by as much as 53%.

articles.title: Financing for California’s signature virtual power plant remains uncertain
articles.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom proposed funding the Demand Side Grid Support program through this year before moving participants to a separate, utility-run framework. Clean energy groups call the proposal costly and counterproductive.

articles.title: Kursk II's first VVER-TOI 'has generated 2 billion kWh'
articles.summary: The 1,250 MW capacity VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II nuclear power plant entered into commercial operation on 1 May, with Rosatom saying it has generated more than 2 billion kWh of electricity since being connected to the grid in December.

articles.title: Construction begins on fourth Taipingling unit
articles.summary: The first nuclear safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 4 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Huizhou in south China's Guangdong province. It is the fourth of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Rosatom continuing work for Iran’s Bushehr units 2 and 3
articles.summary: The reactor for Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant’s unit 2 is more than 60% complete and the steam generators 50% complete, and "we plan to begin shipping the key equipment next year", Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel loading completed at Rooppur 1
articles.summary: The process of loading 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant reactor has been completed.

articles.title: Experiments provide data for SMR passive cooling system simulations
articles.summary: Researchers at Switzerland's Paul Scherrer Institute have experimentally investigated passive cooling systems for small modular reactors, collecting high-resolution measurement data for the first time.

articles.title: Indonesia and Russia discuss nuclear energy cooperation
articles.summary: Rosatom’s Director General Alexei Likhachev has said Russia is ready to offer Indonesia a comprehensive approach to developing its national nuclear programme, ranging from gigawatt-scale units to small modular reactors and floating power plants.

articles.title: First RITM-200 reactor unit manufactured for Leningrad nuclear icebreaker
articles.summary: The RITM-200 reactor unit is the eleventh so far manufactured at the ZiO-Podolsk plant, part of Rosatom's machine-building division.

articles.title: US federal funds awarded to spur SMR deployment
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has selected eight companies to collectively receive more than USD94 million in federal cost-shared funding to support the near-term deployment of advanced light-water small modular reactors in the USA by addressing key barriers in licensing, supply chain, and site readiness.

articles.title: L3Harris finalises design of deep space power source
articles.summary: US technology company L3Harris Technologies announced it has finalised the design of a next-generation nuclear-based power source for future NASA deep space missions, marking a crucial advancement in spacecraft power technology.

articles.title: Contest launched to name UK's first SMR plant
articles.summary: The people of Anglesey in North Wales are being asked to suggest a name which is "easy to pronounce and welcoming to a wide audience" for the small modular reactor plant which is to be built at the Wylfa site on the island.

articles.title: Concrete pouring completed for first part of Cernavoda refurb project
articles.summary: Romania's Nuclearelectrica has announced the completion of concrete pouring for the foundation of the Intermediate Radioactive Waste Storage Facility, which is part of the Cernavoda unit 1 refurbishment project.

articles.title: Blykalla applies to build Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla has submitted an application to the government to construct a power plant in Norrsundet, Gävle, in east central Sweden, comprising six SEALER reactors.

articles.title: Concrete poured for BREST-OD-300 turbine foundation
articles.summary: Concrete has begun being poured for the foundation of the turbine and generator for the BREST-OD-300 lead-cooled fast neutron reactor in Seversk in Russia's Tomsk region.

articles.title: Fourth Finnish municipality to assess nuclear district heating
articles.summary: Finnish small modular reactor developer Steady Energy has signed a letter of intent with municipal energy company Alva-yhtiöt Oy to investigate the suitability of SMRs as a source for district heating in the city of Jyväskylä in central Finland.

articles.title: Holtec and Rwanda advance plans to deploy SMR-300s
articles.summary: Holtec International and the Rwanda Atomic Energy Board have signed a development agreement to work together on the deployment of SMR-300 units. Meanwhile, as Rwanda hosts the Nuclear Energy Innovation Summit for Africa, it has signed a memorandum of understanding on civil nuclear cooperation with the USA.

articles.title: Risks of novel Sizewell C financing model must be monitored, says public auditor
articles.summary: Investors' financial returns on the Sizewell C nuclear power plant project may initially cost UK consumers as much as GBP4 billion (USD5.4 billion) - but in the longer term the net benefits for energy bills could reach GBP18 billion, according to the UK's National Audit Office.

articles.title: Microreactor application accepted for review by US regulator
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has formally accepted the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign's application to construct a research KRONOS micro modular reactor on its campus, launching a detailed safety and environmental review of the project.

articles.title: TerraPower and HD Hyundai sign Natrium reactor agreements
articles.summary: The shipbuilding subsidiary of South Korea's HD Hyundai has been selected as preferred manufacturer for TerraPower's Natrium Reactor Enclosure System components, one of a series of agreements aimed at the "rapid commercialisation and deployment of a fleet of Natrium … plants in the coming years".

articles.title: Jacobs to carry out environmental assessments for UK's Oldbury site
articles.summary: Great British Energy - Nuclear has selected US firm Jacobs to develop environmental baseline data, with AtkinsRéalis and AECOM as subconsultants, on the Oldbury site which is earmarked for new UK nuclear capacity.

articles.title: Kazakhstan outlines localisation plans
articles.summary: The Kazakh government has approved a resolution aimed at developing a domestic industrial base for the implementation of nuclear power plant construction projects.
